name: ebay-optimizer
description: AI eBay listing optimizer - Next.js frontend, Express API, background worker, MongoDB

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev:worker" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,worker,web "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix backend run start:worker" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
